summary: Ruled option (2): the --cached untracking gets its own narrow carve-out, kept distinct from the directory-move carve-out, with options (1) and (3) rejected on recorded evidence. A plan-phase probe superseded the research report's recommended fix as a complete fix: no pathspec-scoped 'git commit -- <paths>' form can carry an untracking whose content remains on disk, so the plan handles the shape end-to-end at three sites in git-commit-scoped.sh (V2 pre-add classification, a guarded index-equivalence-verified commit path, and a V8 intent-snapshot correction), leaving V7's exact-exit-code discrimination untouched. Five sequential phases, 8 hours, covering the fix, the Y-cluster regression suite, the git-staging-scope.md record, and a redeploy plus full gate run.

artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan ruling option (2) and fixing the --cached untracking shape end-to-end in git-commit-scoped.sh, with regression tests, documentation, and a full-gate redeploy.
